item: Document Checklist - Spouse (IMM 5533)
Application to Sponsor (IMM 1344), signed by the sponsor and the principal applicant
Fee receipt (sponsorship, application, biometrics; right of PR fee recommended)
Financial Evaluation (IMM 1283)
condition: the spouse has a dependent child who has their own dependent child (not Quebec)

item: Generic Application Form (IMM 0008)
Country-specific forms
condition: required for the principal applicant's country

item: Additional Family Information (IMM 5406), principal applicant and family members 18 or older
Schedule A (IMM 5669), principal applicant and family members 18 or older
Relationship Information and Sponsorship Evaluation (IMM 5532), signed by both
Use of a Representative (IMM 5476)
Authority to Release Information (IMM 5475)
Sponsor: proof of status (PR card or CoPR; citizenship certificate, birth certificate or passport; or Indian status card)
Sponsor living abroad (citizen): proof of intent to live in Canada
condition: sponsor is a citizen living outside Canada

item: Children together who may be Canadian: birth certificate, passport, citizenship certificate or proof of a proof application
condition: the couple has a child who may be a citizen

item: Sponsor's earlier marriages: divorce, annulment or death certificates
Principal applicant in Canada: proof of status (visa or permit)
Birth certificates of the principal applicant and each dependant
Passports and identity documents (national ID, family booklet where required)
Marriage certificate registered with the authorities (not a solemnization record or licence)
Principal applicant's earlier unions: divorce, annulment or death certificates; earlier sponsorship explanation
condition: principal applicant was married or sponsored before

item: Children: proof of dependency (22 or older) and adoption papers
condition: a dependent child 22 or older, or adopted

item: Police certificates for each country with 6 months or more in a row since 18
note: Canada: not needed now if lived here 6 months; some countries need IRCC consent first

item: Military documents
Photos of the principal applicant and accompanying family
Not living together: proof of contact (10 pages max) and of the sponsor's visits
Living together: at least two sets (joint property or lease, joint accounts, insurance, same-address ID or documents)
Children together: birth certificates naming both parents (long form if born in Canada)
Not all four relationship answers Yes: up to 20 photos with descriptions, and two more sets of evidence
